brain.DESCRIPTION: The brain: the show, the rig state under it, and the calendar the show follows.

show.DESCRIPTION: The show state, test mode included: blackout and run from the calendar, test_pluck and test_blackout in test mode.

rig.DESCRIPTION: The rig state, which says whether, and what, goes out, whatever the show asks.

next_show_s.DESCRIPTION: Time until the next show in the calendar begins to play, by the brain's clock as it stands; 0 while one plays, -1 when the calendar has none to come.

dusk_s.DESCRIPTION: Time until today's civil dusk at the site, by the brain's clock as it stands; 0 once it has passed.

brain.DESCRIPTION: How the brain sends the universe, on top of dmx.oscquery.json, and who has taken it over.

frame_rate_hz.DESCRIPTION: How many frames a second the brain sends.

priority.DESCRIPTION: The sACN priority the brain sends at, which a console must send strictly above to take the universe over.

takeover_ip.DESCRIPTION: The address of the console that has taken the universe over; 0.0.0.0 while the brain drives it.

takeover_priority.DESCRIPTION: The sACN priority of the console that has taken the universe over; 0 while the brain drives it.
